ceiling_directive: Prove converse attainment on the full published Huntington–Klein law class, including discrete or mixed treatments, by replacing the everywhere-positive-density completion with a joint-margin-preserving construction requiring only the primitive nondegeneracy needed to define the long coefficient.
improvement_directive: Strengthen thm:sharp-sign-ratio-closure from conditional-positive-density observed laws to the published class itself, explicitly covering binary-treatment laws such as the comparator's ACS design. The new construction must attain every vector in the sign-ratio union without using a latent control that requires continuous full support.
critique: The exact identified-set equality is proved only for observed laws whose conditional (D_i,U_i) pairs have everywhere-positive Lebesgue densities, a proof-tailored restriction that excludes binary-treatment designs central to the published comparator; over arbitrary published laws the note proves only containment. Consequently, the TL;DR's statement that the union is the exact causal effect set on the published specialization is broader than the theorem unless its later density qualification is imported into that sentence. The singularity-robust inference results concern a project-defined polynomial supershort sensitivity region rather than the published causal identified set, and the adaptive selector is only an existence construction with no globally implementable certification rule. Thus the delivered contribution is a useful but subclass-limited correction and computational characterization, not yet a field-level resolution of the published problem.
